  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 8, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on February 08, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Brian Walker /Crystal Mcglover, Emergency Services / Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on January 25, 2024.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Judith Wilson DBA HJ New Way Recovery Inc. to host a Monthly Drive Thru-Food
  Distribution Event at 8722 Crenshaw Blvd.; Morningside United Church Parking Lot;
  Private Property, every 3rd and/or 4th Thursday of each month, from Thursday, February
  15,204 – December 19, 2024, from 1:00 p.m – 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to all
  recommendations outlined by the IPD / Planninng Department; Applicant Approved for the
  monthly event at Morningside United Church Parking Lot; Applicant to hire (2) Licensed
  Professional Security Guards for the safety of attendees and employees; All Security
  Guards / Event Staff shall wear reflective vests; A Watch Commander will be notified;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383575)
 Permits & License Committee  January 8, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 5

Item #2:  David Rice DBA Taste of Inglewood to host a Taste of Inglewood Big Game Block Party
  Event on Market Street, from Manchester to Nutwood and from Market Market St. to La
  Brea, Public Property, on Sunday, February 11, 2024 from 11:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m.; and
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Applicant to adhere to all recommendations outlined by the IPD / Planning Department,
  and Public Works Department; Applicant to hire one (1) Sergeant; eight (8) Inglewood
  Police Officers; twelve (12) TCO’s; thirty (30) Licensed Professional Security Guards to
  assist IPD with public safety; two(2) Security Guards must be present o check ID where
  alcohol is being sold to ensure alcohol isn’t sold to minors; NO alcohol outside the event;
  NO public drinking; must submit the traffic control plan to public works; payment for the
  event must be received by February 8, 2024;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00383510).

Item #3:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of the City of Inglewood to host a 2nd Annual Black History
  Celebration Event at Downtown Inglewood on Market Street from Regent Street to Hillcrest
  Blvd., Public Property, on Saturday, February 24, 2024 from 11:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: IPD
  will staff one (1) Lieutenant; Two (2) Sergeants; ten (10) Inglewood Police Officers; fourteen
  (14) TCO’s and ten (10) City hall Security Offcers; No Service Sales or Alcohol Beverages;
  must contact Public Works Department with a Traffice Control Plan; Maintain site at all
  times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and
  staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00383571).
  New Business License Request(s):

Item # 4:  Andre L Jennings DBA Los Angeles Executive Security Group, Inc. to operate as Guard
  Services at 415 E Tamarack Ave. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Maintain
  valid and current Private Patrol Operator License from the Department of Consumer Affairs,
  Bureau of Security and Investigative Services; Security Guards must be licensed with the
  Department of Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Security and Investigative Services; Business
  owner/facility is strictly prohibited from hiring or employing any person registered under
  California Penal Code Section 290 PC or any person that may pose a public safety
  risk/threat to patients or other employees at the location; and Adhere to all State, Federal
  and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signal
 Permits & License Committee  January 8, 2024
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

  Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00362978).
Item # 5: Rose Zeleya DBA Parking Network, Inc. to operate as Parking Lot at 323 N. Prairie Ave.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Payment
  of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed license for more than six months
  will negatively impact your license renewal; Remittances of Parking Tax by the 20th of each
  month following collection; Approval for Special Event Parking Forum events only; Special
  Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday through Friday; On-Site business must be
  closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts. Parking attendants or security guards must be on
  site during event parking at all times; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off
  site and; Adhere to all State, Federal, and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the
  revocation of your business license and any future license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00362978).

Item # 6: Ogheneovo Ohwojeheri DBA TTMIKKI and EMMA Inc. to operate as a Shuttle Service at 323
  N. Prairie Ave. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license renewal and tax fees; All employees
  must have a current valid driver’s License. All vehicles must have proof of current valid vehicle
  registration and insurance at all times. If required a Class P-Charter Party Permit must be
  obtained. Applicant/owner shall NOT employ or have any 290 PC registrants employed or any
  persons that may pose a threat to the safety of patrons or the general public. Adhere to all
  State, Federal, and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your
  business license and any future Business License application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00383303).
